_meta_note: budget-grid-view REQ-BGV-001..009 — the year-basis begroting grid (verzamelpost rows, any period range, past-period actuals-vs-budget deviation, TOTAAL cumulative column). Nests as a new child under the 'Budgets' top-level group budget-core-schema already created on this branch (proposal.md's Impact section: whichever change lands the group first creates it — budget-core-schema did, here it merges in by menu id via mergeMenuItems()).

pages.title: Budget Grid
pages._note: Rows are a LedgerGroup TREE (root verzamelposten expandable to child groups or resolved grootboek accounts), not a flat list of one schema's objects, and columns are a caller-selected period range/granularity with a computed TOTAAL cumulative column — `type: index` cannot express nesting or generated columns, `type: dashboard` cannot express row-level drill/expand. Fetches its whole payload once from GET /api/budget-grid; expand/collapse is client-side only (design.md §1c). See BudgetLineCommitments/WbsoChartOfAccountsView for the same type:custom precedent.
